A big update: a new look, text reading in scans and comics, smarter reviews, and a round of security fixes.

## New
- **Redesigned app.** Library, reader, words and review were rebuilt from scratch, with light and dark themes.
- **Read text in scans, images and comics.** Scanned PDFs, photos, CBZ manga and webtoons get a selectable text layer, so you can translate and save words from them too. This works offline and includes Japanese vertical text.
- **Pick up where you left off.** Books reopen at the page you were on, and word selection is more precise.

## Fixed
- **Review progress no longer gets lost.** Words with accents or in non-Latin scripts (é, ş, Cyrillic, Japanese and others) used to lose their progress on restart.
- **Fairer review scheduling.** Only your first answer in a session counts, "Unsure" counts as a pass, and a word leaves the session after one right answer.

## Security
- **Opening a PDF is safe again.** The Chromium sandbox is back on, a strict Content-Security-Policy blocks injected scripts, and the app reads only files you open. pdf.js is updated to 6.5, which fixes a flaw that let a malicious PDF run code.
- **Your DeepL key is stored encrypted.** It is never included in backups or phone sync. Settings shows only its last four characters.
- **Phone sync is protected.** The 4-digit PIN is replaced by a long one-time code in the QR code. Wrong guesses get locked out, and pairing stops after one sync or 10 minutes.
- **Updated to Electron 45** and current dependencies.

## Notes
- Windows and macOS builds aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may warn the first time you open the app.
- On Linux, the AppImage runs without the Chromium sandbox on systems that block it, such as Ubuntu 24.04. The .deb keeps the sandbox on.
